{{LastEdited}} }} [[File:Private Island Stranded.png|300px|thumb|right]] '''Stranded''' is a [[Gamemode]] where the player can only travel between their {{Zone|Private Island}} and {{Zone|The Garden}}. Additionally, Stranded profiles are similar to {{Gamemode|Ironman}} profiles in that they do not allow [[Trading]] with players outside of the [[Co-op]], they use the [[Bazaar#Special Bazaar|Special Bazaar]], and the [[Auction House]] cannot be accessed on Stranded. The gamemode was officially declared End of Life on August 13, 2025 and will receive one final update to fix some of the most affecting issues.https://hypixel.net/threads/stranded-upcoming-end-of-life-update.5970022/ == Overview == Stranded profiles can be played Solo or as a Co-op. Players on Stranded profiles are restricted to their [[Private Island]] and [[Garden]] for the entirety of the game, so there are several changes to make parts of the game's content obtainable. Players are able to place down certain NPCs on their island, such as {{NPCSprite|Jacob}} and {{NPCSprite|Maddox the Slayer}}, to make their respective content available. NPCs can be unlocked by reaching a specific milestone, such as reaching a certain [[Skill]] level or obtaining a specific item. Players can also trade with [[#Villagers|Villagers]], crops grow faster on the {{Zone|Private Island}}, and plenty of requirements such as [[Dungeon]] Requirements and [[Faction]] Requirements on items and minions are ignored. == Mobs == On Stranded profiles, the level of some naturally spawning hostile mobs is the same as the player's {{skl|Combat}} level. For example, a player with {{Skill|Combat|7}} will have mostly level 7 monsters spawn on their island. All monsters require darkness to spawn. [[Runecrafting#Runic Mobs|Runic Mobs]] can also spawn on Stranded profiles. Below is the list of mobs that can spawn on Stranded profiles. {{Coll S B|id=mobs|name=Show/Hide Mob List}} {{Coll S|id=mobs|{{Transclude|Stranded/Mobs}}}} == NPCs == NPCs can be summoned by clicking on the [[File:Villager Spawn Egg.png|21px]] Island NPCs button in the {{Item|SkyBlock Menu}}. Doing so will open a menu with all of the NPCs that can be summoned, including the requirements to summon each NPC. {{:Stranded NPCs/UI}} {{Coll S B|id=npcs|name=Show/Hide NPC List}} {{Coll S|id=npcs|{{Transclude|Stranded/NPCs}}}} == Collections == Many collection materials cannot be obtained in the same way as in the Classic and Ironman gamemode. Once enough materials have been collected, Minions are usually a very useful way to obtain more of the same material. Below is a table with information on how to progress in all collections. To see the spawning requirements for a mob in the table, click on the corresponding link. {{Coll S B|id=items|name=Show/Hide Collection List}} {{Coll S|id=items|mode=begin}} {{Transclude|Stranded/Collections}} {{Coll S|id=items|mode=end}} == Villagers == Villagers can be obtained from curing [[#Zombie Villager|Zombie Villagers]]. Players can sell some items to Villagers in exchange for {{Item|Emerald}}s and {{Item|Enchanted Emerald}}s. Players can then exchange these Emeralds and Enchanted Emeralds for [[Pets]], [[Dark Auction]] items, and items from [[Shops|Merchant NPCs]], among other things. === Curing Zombie Villagers === [[#Zombie Villager|Zombie Villagers]] can be cured by being fed a {{Item|Golden Apple}} while under the {{Pot|Weakness}} effect, just like in vanilla Minecraft. Golden Apples can be obtained as a {{Rare}} drop from fishing or by crafting with gold from killing {{MobSprite|Redstone Pigman}}. The Weakness effect can be obtained by having a [[#Witch|Witch]] throw a Splash Potion of Weakness onto the Zombie Villager or by [[brewing]] a Splash {{PotionName|Weakness Potion}}. === Villager Leveling === Villagers level up after a set number of Emeralds are traded. When a Villager levels up, it unlocks more trades. After a level is reached, the counter resets. Enchanted Emeralds count as 160 Emeralds for Villager leveling. {| class="wikitable" ! Level !! Emeralds Needed !! Cumulative |- | 1 || (none) || 0 |- | 2 || 50 || 50 |- | 3 || 400 || 450 |- | 4 || 1050 || 1500 |- | 5 || 1500 || 3000 |} === Villager Trades === The list of Villager trades is shown below. The first table shows items that the player can give to a Villager for {{Item|Emerald|amount=1|link=}}, and the second table shows items that the player can buy with {{Item|Emerald|link=}}s or {{Item|Enchanted Emerald|link=}}s. {{/Trades}} === Notes on Villagers === * Villagers do not despawn. * Villagers cannot be bred. * The prices offered by a single Villager never change. * Punching or otherwise harming a Villager does not affect the prices. * The prices offered by different Villagers when trading items for Emeralds can differ slightly between Villagers, but prices when trading Emeralds for other items are always the same for that item. * Hostile creatures do not attack Villagers. * If there are at least six Villagers on the island, [[#Iron Golem|Iron Golem]]s will spawn, allowing the player to unlock the {{Coll|Iron Ingot|img=y}} collection. * Villagers move very quickly once cured, so it is advised to cure Zombie Villagers after they are trapped. * Villagers tend to clip through walls, so it is best to use a solid block at their feet and a non-solid block at head level. Using a solid block at head level can suffocate them. * Do not place a ceiling directly above them since this can cause mobs to clip through the floor. * The first Villager cured on each profile is guaranteed to have the {{Item|Desert Island}} trade. If this Villager dies, the next does not have the same guarantee. * A bug causes Villagers to occasionally load as vanilla villagers. This applies to all Villagers when it happens and can be fixed by reloading the island (go to the lobby, wait at least five seconds, and rejoin). Trading with vanilla villagers does not count towards collections. == Trades Menu == The Stranded [[Trades]] menu that can be accessed through /trade has a few changes. The {{Item|Portal to the Hub}} Trade is removed and there are a few additional trades exclusive to Stranded. The regular water and lava bucket trades are still available upon meeting their normal requirements. === Exclusive Trades === {| class="wikitable" !Requirement !Trade Input !Trade Output |- |{{CollectionLink|None}} |{{Coins|10000|image_in_front=yes}} |{{Item|Water Bucket|amount=1|link=}} |- |{{CollectionLink|None}} |{{Coins|25000|image_in_front=yes}} |{{Item|Lava Bucket|amount=1|link=}} |- |{{Skill|Foraging|2}} |{{Item|Enchanted Oak Wood|amount=2}} |{{Item|Birch Sapling|amount=1|link=}} |- |{{Skill|Foraging|4}} |{{Item|Enchanted Birch Wood|amount=4}} |{{Item|Spruce Sapling|amount=1|link=}} |- |{{Skill|Foraging|6}} |{{Item|Enchanted Spruce Wood|amount=6}} |{{Item|Dark Oak Sapling|amount=4|link=}} |- |{{Skill|Foraging|8}} |{{Item|Enchanted Dark Oak Wood|amount=8}} |{{Item|Acacia Sapling|amount=1|link=}} |- |{{Skill|Foraging|10}} |{{Item|Enchanted Acacia Wood|amount=10}} |{{Item|Jungle Sapling|amount=1|link=}} |- |{{CollectionLink|Sand 2|showIcon=yes}} |{{Item|Sand|amount=1}} |{{Item|Red Sand|amount=1}} |- |{{CollectionLink|Mushroom 2|showIcon=yes}} |{{RL|1x Dirt|1x Red Mushroom|1x Brown Mushroom}} |{{Item|Mycelium|amount=1}} |} == Events == Players on Stranded profiles can participate in most [[Events]], but some Events do not affect Stranded profiles. === Recurring Events === * [[File:Wheat.png|21px|link=Jacob's Farming Contest]] [[Jacob's Farming Contest]]: {{yes}} Jacob and Anita can be found in the Island NPCs menu and in {{Zone|The Garden}}. * [[File:Nether Brick.png|21px|link=Dark Auction]] [[Dark Auction]]: {{no}} Dark Auctions are not available, but many items from the Dark Auction are obtainable by trading with [[#Villagers|Villagers]]. * [[File:New Year Celebration.png|21px|link=New Year Celebration]] [[New Year Celebration]]: {{yes}} The {{NPCSprite|Baker}} can be found in the Island NPCs menu. * [[File:Traveling Zoo.png|21px|link=Traveling Zoo]] [[Traveling Zoo]]: {{yes}} {{NPCSprite|Oringo}} can be found in the Island NPCs menu. Spawning Oringo requires 6 unique pets. * [[File:Hoppity Head.png|21px|link=Hoppity's Hunt]] [[Hoppity's Hunt]]: {{yes}} {{NPCSprite|Hoppity}} can be found in the Island NPCs menu. * [[File:Spooky Festival.png|21px|link=Spooky Festival]] [[Spooky Festival]]: {{Yellow|(partial)}} ** Spooky Mobs can spawn on the Private Island on Stranded profiles. ** Spooky Sea Creatures can also be fished up. ** The {{MobSprite|Headless Horseman}} can be spawned on the private island. ** The {{NPCSprite|Fear Mongerer}} can be found in the Island NPCs menu. Spawning The Fear Mongerer requires {{Skill|Combat|5}}. ** Leaderboard rewards can still be obtained from the Events menu in the {{Item|SkyBlock Menu}}. *** Note: score is capped at '''5,000 [[Spooky_Festival#Points|points]]''' for Stranded Profiles ** The {{Item|Bat Firework}} cannot be purchased. Instead, {{MobSprite|Bat Piñata}}s will occasionally spawn. ** {{MobSprite|Crazy Witch}}es fully heal very frequently, but it is barely possible to kill them. For example, they can be killed by trapping them in lava, using a {{Item|Starlight Wand}}, and hitting them frequently. * [[File:Season of Jerry.png|21px|link=Season of Jerry]] [[Season of Jerry]] and other [[Winter Island]] features: {{Yellow|(partial)}} ** The [[Winter Island]] cannot be visited, but Stranded players can fish up [[Winter Sea Creatures]] on the Private Island any time during {{Season|m=Late Winter}}. ** Fishing up Winter Sea Creatures is the only way to obtain Gifts since Stranded players cannot travel to the [[Winter Island]] to participate in the [[Defend Jerry's Workshop]] event. ** Players can open any type of [[Gift]] by placing it on the ground and opening it as usual, even on a Solo profile. ** On [[Co-op]] profiles, giving the gift to a Co-op member instead of oneself will give the reward to both players, resulting in essentially double drops. ** Rewards from the [[Chicken Race]] can be bought from Villagers. * [[File:Mayor Election.png|21px|link=Mayor Election]] [[Mayor Election]]: {{no}} ** Elections cannot be voted on by players on Stranded profiles. ** Players on Stranded profiles cannot interact with elected mayors. ** Many mayor perks still apply to Stranded profiles, so it is still beneficial to vote on the election from a non-Stranded profile. ** For more information on which mayor perks apply to Stranded, see [[#Mayors|§ Mayors]] below. === Mayor Events === * [[File:Mythological Ritual.png|21px|link=Mythological Ritual]] [[Mythological Ritual]] ([[Diana]]): {{no}} Unavailable * [[File:Iron Pickaxe.png|21px|link=Mining Fiesta]] [[Mining Fiesta]] ([[Cole]]/[[Foxy]]): {{no}} Unavailable * [[File:Fishing Festival.png|21px|link=Fishing Festival]] [[Fishing Festival]] ([[Marina]]/[[Foxy]]): {{yes}} Available === Other Events === * {{Gamemode|Bingo}}: The Bingo interface can be opened via the /bingo command, allowing access to the Bingo profile, card, and shop. Items cannot be transferred from a Bingo profile to a Stranded profile. * {{no}} [[File:aPunch Century Cake.png|21px|link=Century Cake]] [[Century Cake]]: {{NPCSprite|Simon}} was not in the Island NPCs menu during the Year 200 event, so he is unlikely to appear for future century events. * {{yes}} [[File:SkyBlock Anniversary Event.png|21px|link=SkyBlock Anniversary]] [[SkyBlock Anniversary]]: During the 3rd to 6th [[SkyBlock Anniversary]] events, {{NPCSprite|Simon}} was in the Island NPCs Menu, and Stranded players were able to claim the Party Hat. ** {{no}} [[File:Shiny Orb.png|21px|link=Shiny Pig]] [[Shiny Pig]]s: The {{NPCSprite|Pig Shop}} was available in the Island NPCs Menu during the 3rd to 5th SkyBlock Anniversary events. However, since this was moved to Year of the Pig, it does not function properly. During Year of the Pig, nothing appears on Stranded. During SkyBlock Anniversaries, Shiny Pigs spawn but the Pig Shop is unavailable. == Mayors == While [[Mayor Election#Candidates|mayors]] cannot be voted on or spoken with on Stranded profiles, many perks still apply. * {{NPCSprite|Aatrox}}: {{yes}} All perks apply as usual. * {{NPCSprite|Cole}}: {{Yellow|(partial)}} Since his ''Mining XP Buff'' perk and the [[Mining Fiesta]] event only work on public islands, and that there is no access to [[The Forge]] so ''Molten Forge'' has no purpose, the only one of his perks that affects Stranded is the ''Prospection'' perk, which increases the speed of Mining Minions by 25%. * {{NPCSprite|Diana}}: {{Yellow|(partial)}} The [[Mythological Ritual]] event is only available on the Hub Island. The {{Item|Griffin Pet}} cannot be obtained because the mayors cannot be spoken with on Stranded. Her other perks, ''Pet XP Buff'', ''Lucky!'' and ''Sharing is Caring,'' apply as usual. * {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}: {{Yellow|(partial)}} Because you can't access Shen's Auction or Stonks Auction on Stranded profiles, her only perk that applies is ''Shopping Spree.'' * {{NPCSprite|Finnegan}}: {{Yellow|(partial)}} All perks apply as usual, except for some mechanics of the [[Grand Feast]] as you cannot visit [[Feast Baker Scott]] to trade in [[Kernels]] for items as he is located on the hub island. * {{NPCSprite|Foxy}}: {{Yellow|(partial)}} Because Carnivals can't be accessed in Stranded, the only perk that applies to Stranded profiles is her ''Extra Events'' if it happens to be Fishing Festival or Spooky Festival and ''Sweet Benevolence'' applies as usual{{Confirm}}. * {{NPCSprite|Marina}}: {{yes}} The ''Fishing XP Buff'' perk includes Stranded islands, and her other perks apply as usual. * {{NPCSprite|Paul}}: {{no}} Since dungeons are not available, none of Paul's perks apply to Stranded profiles. === Special Candidates === * {{NPCSprite|Derpy}}: {{Yellow|(partial)}} All perks apply as usual, except the ''QUAD TAXES!!!'' perk does not affect Stranded because Stranded players cannot access the Auction House and Bazaar* anyway. (*Except for booster cookies.) * {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}}: {{yes}} All perks apply as usual. * {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}}: {{no}} Since mayors cannot be spoken with on Stranded, his ''Bribe'' perk does not apply. Since the Dark Auction cannot be accessed, his only other perk, ''Darker Auctions'', also does not apply. === One-Time Candidates === Many items that were only obtainable while the mayor was {{NPCSprite|Dante}} or {{NPCSprite|Technoblade}} can be obtained by trading with Villagers. During the {{Pink|3rd SkyBlock Anniversary}} event, the {{NPCSprite|Pig Shop}} was available in the Island NPCs Menu, and [[Shiny Pig]]s spawned on the island during part of the event. == Fishing == A few changes were made to {{skill|Fishing}} for Stranded profiles only. * The debuff to {{Stat|scc}} on the Private Island is removed. * Fishing bobbers can deal damage to mobs. * [[Sea Creatures]] that usually only spawn in some specific locations can be fished up on the Private Island. * The {{MobSprite|Abyssal Miner}} drops {{Item|Nether Quartz}}. * {{MobSprite|Water Worm}}s drop {{Item|Hard Stone}}. * Name Tags are a {{RawMctxt|&5&lGREAT CATCH!}} from Fishing, and they can be used to prevent mobs from despawning (up to 5 are able to be used). * The Fishing {{Item|Fairy Soul}}s can be collected like normal, but there is no way to trade them in for buffs, so the only use for Fairy Souls is the Full Set Bonus of {{Item|Fairy Armor}}. * Changing the Biome with a {{Item|Deep Ocean Biome Stick}} grants {{Statname|scc|+5}} in that area. === Lava Fishing === Lava Fishing is possible by summoning {{NPCSprite|Odger}} from the [[#NPCs|Island NPCs]] Menu and getting a {{Item|Starter Lava Rod}}. * The chance for Sea Creatures to be [[Corrupted Mobs|Corrupted]] when Lava Fishing increases by {{Green|0.1%}} per {{Skl|Fishing}} level. * {{Item|Magma Rod}}s can be crafted upon reaching {{Collection|Magmafish|4}} (1000 {{Item|Magmafish}}) and used upon reaching {{Skill|Fishing|27}} . * Lava Fishing is the only way to increase the {{Item|Netherrack}} and {{Item|Magmafish}} collections. === Trophy Fishing === The requirements for catching [[Trophy Fish]] are different on Stranded profiles. {{Coll S B|id=trophy-fish|name=Show/Hide Trophy Fish List}} {{Coll S|id=trophy-fish|{{Transclude|Stranded/Trophy Fish}}}} === Sea Guardians === * In addition to being able to be fished up, {{MobSprite|Sea Guardian}}s used to spawn naturally in water under the following conditions: ** The biome in the area must have been changed with a {{Item|Deep Ocean Biome Stick}}. ** The water must be at least 3 blocks deep, and flowing water does count. ** They spawn more frequently when there are more viable spots for them to spawn, including vertically. For example, they can spawn in a 2 wide channel, but they would spawn extremely slowly. ** They will not spawn if there are already six of them on the island. * They have the same stats and drops as the normal variant that can be fished up. * {{Item|Lily Pad}}s obtained from killing these Sea Guardians do count towards the collection. * Unlike in vanilla Minecraft, Sea Guardians can drown if they are underwater for long enough. However, it takes a while due to their high health. ** Because of this, they will naturally float to the top of the water. * Killing these Sea Guardians does not count towards the {{Item|Dolphin Pet}} milestones. == Jerry's Tips == Tips can be bought from {{NPCSprite|Jerry}} for {{Coins|1000}} each. These tips are hints for Stranded-specific mechanics. For example, the tip ''"In my opinion, Magma Cubes are just fiery slimes."'' is a hint for the mechanic where {{MobSprite|Magma Cube}}s can be spawned by setting {{MobSprite|Slime}}s on fire. Upon purchasing a tip from Jerry, the player will receive one of the following messages in chat: * {{Green|Villagers}} {{White|tend to have}} {{Pink|sweet}} {{White|trades!}} * {{White|Did you know}} {{Green|Slimes}} {{White|can spawn near the void?}} * {{Green|Cocoa Beans}} {{White|only grow on one type of tree!}} * {{White|Shiny creatures can drop}} {{Aqua|shiny}} {{White|things!}} * {{Green|Rabbits}} {{White|can spawn in different biomes!}} * {{White|I've heard that scary monsters can attack your island sometime in}} {{Orange|Autumn}}{{White|.}} * {{White|The only way to obtain}} {{Green|Emeralds}} {{White|is to trade for them!}} * {{Orange|Pigmen}} {{White|are great at hoarding wealth.}} * {{White|This place desperately needs more}} {{Green|Iron Golems}}{{White|!}} * {{White|In my opinion,}} {{Red|Magma Cubes}} {{White|are just fiery slimes.}} * {{Green|Villagers}} {{White|tend to have cool trades!}} == The Garden == {{Zone|The Garden}} is generally the same as it is for other profiles, with the following differences. * Talking to visitors is not required to unlock them. Garden Level requirements are unchanged. * When pasting a plot, crops cannot be purchased from the [[Bazaar]]. * The [[Fast Travel]] button in the {{Item|SkyBlock Menu}} is replaced with a button that takes the player straight from their island to the Garden, or vice versa. * {{NPCSprite|Tia the Fairy}}'s dialogue as a Garden visitor on Stranded profiles is changed to ''It's a shame you can't visit public islands. If you ever do, I have a quest for you.'' == Trivia == * There is a limit of {{Green|1,000}} {{MobSprite|Villager;Villagers}} on the player's [[Private
